files.README.md:
# Selcove Aquaculture - tank farm

Shared folder for the hatchery team.

- tanks/  cards for each tank on the farm
- grades/  grading notes from the deck

turns.prompt: A hatchery hand at Selcove Aquaculture asked what the stocking density on a tank card describes; it is the mass of fish held in a tank spread over the volume of water the tank holds. Tank 38 holds 3780 kilograms of fish in 210 cubic metres of water. Give the stocking density as a single number in kilograms per cubic metre, with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
